headline_marked: Detention beyond 24 hours [[to be considered disappearance]]
headline: Detention beyond 24 hours to be considered disappearance
summary: Chief Prosecutor Aminul Islam states that holding a person in a secret location without notifying the family for over 24 hours will be treated as an enforced disappearance.
details: Chief Prosecutor Aminul Islam announced that if law enforcement agencies hold a person for more than 24 hours without notifying their family, it will be regarded as a disappearance.
During a briefing at the tribunal on Monday, he clarified that any period of detention beyond 24 hours where the individual is denied legal recourse will be considered a disappearance.
He noted that the Enforced Disappearance Prevention and Remedy Act has been passed by the National Parliament, which defines such acts as separate criminal offenses.
According to the law, it is a crime if law enforcement agencies hide the location of a person after arrest or detention, keep them in an unknown location, or deprive them of legal benefits.
The Chief Prosecutor also mentioned a specific condition for classifying such incidents as crimes against humanity.

He explained that if disappearances are carried out on a wide scale or follow a specific pattern or method, they will be considered crimes against humanity and will be tried at the International Crimes Tribunal.
caption:

According to the law, it is a crime if law enforcement agencies hide the location of a person after arrest or detention, keep them in an unknown location, or deprive them of legal benefits.

The Chief Prosecutor also mentioned a specific condition for classifying such incidents as crimes against humanity.

headline: 9 arrested in Savar police officer killing, RAB says
summary: The Rapid Action Battalion has detained 9 suspects, including members of teen gangs, in connection with the murder of a Sub-Inspector in Savar.
details: The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested 9 suspects in connection with the killing of a police officer in Savar. The arrests were made by RAB-10 and RAB-4, with four suspects being picked up from Sadarghat.
caption:
9 suspects arrested in the killing of a Savar police officer. RAB reveals links to teen gangs and drugs.

The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested 9 suspects in connection with the killing of a police officer in Savar. The arrests were made by RAB-10 and RAB-4, with four suspects being picked up from Sadarghat.
